course_name_original: Theory and Practise of Metal Forming
course_name_en: Theory and Practice of Metal Forming
prerequisites: Finished bachelor graduation from a Technical University.

learning_outcomes.text: Gain basic theoretical and practical knowledge in metal forming processes through education.

syllabus_topics: Classification of production methods, characteristics of metal forming processes
Tensile test - stress-strain curves, flow stress, deformation resistance
Stress-strain relationships in elasticity and plasticity, tensor calculation
Workability of metals
Overview of basic metal forming criteria
Methods for analyzing metalworking processes
Fundamentals of sheet metal forming theory, classification, shearing and bending
Deep drawing, loads and energy calculation, determination of forming limit strains
Heating process in metal forming processes
Fundamentals of bulk metal forming theory, classification, open die forging
Fundamentals of upsetting, rolling, and extrusion processes
Closed die forging processes and related operations
Metal forming machines classification, selection of forging equipment
Safety instructions, a load-extension curve and stress-strain curve
Stress and strain calculations
Plain-strain compression (Ford test)
Determination of the strain-hardening exponent from the tensile test
Determination of deformation resistance by an upsetting test
Determination of plasticity reserve by means of a grid method
Limiting draw ratio (LDR) for the first draw
Measurement of the plastic anisotropy ratio; normal and planar anisotropy
Forging loads calculation according to Tomlenov
Methods of determining forming limit diagrams (K-G curves)
Measurement of loads in the extrusion processes
Calculations of loads and energy parameters in forming processes
Assessment, alternative students' reports
bibliography: Valberg, H.S.: Applied Metal Forming inclluding FEM Analysis. Cambridge University Press, 2010
Hosford W.F., Caddell R.M.: Metal Forming - Mechanics and Metalurgy, 4th Edition. Cambridge University Press, 2011
E.M.Mielnik: Metalworking Science and Engineering, McGraw-Hill Inc., 1991
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
